claim_one_line: THE GEOMETRY OF THE FOREIGN 16s IS RIGID -- AND IT IS *NOT* A GENERATION COUNT. THIS ARC'S DRAFT HEADLINE WAS 'the generation count is forced at three' AND IT IS REFUTED, by a test the record itself supplied: docs/OPEN_PROBLEMS.md section C ('Multiplicity -> the generation count') was CLOSED on 2026-08-30 because B324 showed the candidate three there were g-CONJUGATES sharing one character, hence tautological -- and ALL 15 SIXTEEN-BLOCKS HERE LIE IN A SINGLE WEYL ORBIT (orbit size 27), so the three 16s in every triple are W(E6)-conjugates sharing one character and 'three' counts CONJUGATES, NOT SPECIES. A patch to docs/THE_SM_VERDICT.md written on the dead basis was REVERTED before the suite ran. Recorded as E63. WHAT IS REAL: the W6 layer B891 registered on 2026-08-04 ('the next W6 layer is structural: the pairwise geometry of the three 16s') and which went UNRUN FOR THIRTEEN MONTHS OF ARCS -- computed here on B1250's construction. Each mod-2 weight-character with so(10) stabiliser cuts a 16-block from the 27; there are 15, all DISTINCT, and the geometry is RIGID: pairwise |A n B| takes exactly TWO values, 8 (45 pairs) and 10 (60 pairs); exactly 11 of 455 triples have EMPTY triple intersection and every one has |AnB| = |AnC| = |BnC| = 8 with |A u B u C| = 24 of 27 (residue 3); and the maximum mutually-independent family is 3. Two-sided control over 300 random collections of 15 random 16-subsets of a 27-set: max family 2 in 288 cases and 3 in only 12 (~4%), distinct pairwise-overlap values 5..9 and NEVER 2 (0/300) -- so the RIGIDITY is genuinely non-generic. What that control tested was rigidity; the question was INEQUIVALENCE, and it is the latter that decides the reading. ALSO VERIFIED, as a check on B1252's DERIVED hypercharge: all six SM anomalies cancel (with a discriminating control -- shifting Y(e^c) by 1/6 breaks Y^3 and Y.grav^2); hypercharge is conserved on ALL 45 cubic terms; Y on the 16 is exactly the SM set, on the 10 exactly two Higgs doublets plus the colour-triplet pair (not assumed), on the 1 exactly {0}, and traceless overall; and the full SM Yukawa sector is present in the 40 10.16.16 terms (up, down, charged-lepton, Dirac-neutrino, plus the 24 expected GUT proton-decay operators). These are CONSISTENCY VERIFICATIONS -- a 16 of SO(10) is anomaly-free by construction and the Yukawa structure is standard -- valuable because a wrong Y would have failed them on any of 45 terms. AND the principal decomposition COMPUTED NOT CITED: 27 = Sym^16 + Sym^8 + Sym^0 = 17+9+1 with B1252's exact metric, so B632's h^1 = 3 splits as 1 (trivial, ABELIAN) + 1 (Sym^8) + 1 (Sym^16).
